Thanks Jade — great to meet the team. Short answers inline, then an attached proposed minimal scope (MOP) and timeline.

API routes / SDK:
- Non-streaming generation: POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate (payload: model, prompt, max_tokens, temperature).
- Streaming (SSE / chunked): POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate/stream (same payload; use SDK v0.9+ for built-in client).
- Tool calling / function hooks: provide a `tools` array in the request and set `function_call: \"auto\"` or a specific `name`; our SDK will surface the parsed call so you can route to your search service.

Function-calling example (JS, SDK snippet) — included in attachments (sdk_integration_diagram.png shows flow).

Success criteria (proposed):
- Accuracy: <= 5% regression vs. your golden prompts (F1 / exact-match metric we define together).
- Latency: p95 <= 120ms for streaming tokens during 50 qps sustained.
- Stability: no more than 3 timeouts/errors per 10k requests.
- Cost estimate: Redwood provides a projected token cost based on your sample — included in MOP v1.

Timeline (two-week rapid trial):
- Day 0 (Wed): Redwood enables trial workspace + API keys; Skyline uploads golden prompts and sample dataset.
- Day 1–3: Integration + baseline runs (SDK wiring, basic end-to-end).
- Day 4–8: Focused evaluation (latency tests, function-calling validation, streaming load tests).
- Day 9–12: Regression analysis and joint QA; document gaps.
- Day 13–14: Final review and acceptance decision.

Ownership:
- Redwood: marissa_cole (technical PM) and ben_carter (solutions engineer) will be primary contacts for delivery and troubleshooting.
- Skyline: jade.park (ML lead) and oliver.grant (platform) will run evaluation and provide datasets.

Attachments: skyline_poc_mop_v1.pdf (MOP with acceptance gates), sdk_integration_diagram.png

We’ll push the trial workspace once you confirm the data transfer method. For InfoSec notes: SOC2 link is here: https://redwood.box.com/s/abc123 — I’ve also asked Security to respond to your audit log question in a follow-up to security@skyline.ai.

Quick ask: can you confirm a preferred start date (Wed or Thu this week)? If Wed, we’ll target Day 0 as Wed and aim to have keys to you before noon.

—

Marissa — Wed works for us. Two quick technical notes from platform:
1) We run client-side batching for cost savings; want to validate that Redwood’s batching/caching suggestion won’t break our function-calling routing.
2) For streaming tests we’ll simulate real user sessions (interleaved queries + tool calls). Can you confirm that the trial environment supports per-request tool state (KV cache) or do we need to manage session state on our side?

Also, InfoSec requires the retention window for request/response logs — default retention in trial environment is acceptable if it’s configurable.

Thanks — we’ll share the anonymized sample dataset in the secure upload link (sent separately).
